answer: Admission runs through BrandGate, a verifier that hashes a recorded livestock brand against the RFID premises tag fitted to the animal, so one herd cannot back two accounts. A duplicate brand or a tag already bound to another address fires the duplicate-brand penalty, cancelling the brand and forfeiting the posted bond, so each fake identity is a fresh loss instead of a copy. One head costs about 75 dollars in brand recording, 3 dollars for the tag and 40 minutes of inspector travel over meadow and karst, so N fakes cost N times that plus the herd, and a lotus pond changes nothing.
